rows: - Tier run: black-box integration through a real socket against the production bundle: 3 files, 80 tests, all green (about 30 s); prettier and typecheck of the package clean. The git half runs against real repositories: a temporary working tree with a bare local `origin`, a second clone to move origin ahead, a real merge conflict. The pull-request half puts a stub `gh` first on the service's `PATH` that records its working directory and argv and replies from a file, so the suite sees exactly what the service asks `gh` and never touches GitHub.
